notes.title: Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Greetings, cowboys!

A Hotfix is available for Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR today. This update will automatically install when starting the Steam client; if it doesn’t install automatically, please restart Steam. 

Fixed bug with not displaying stars for the completed levels after finishing Act 3 Level 3

We are committed to making playing Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR most comfortable and the best experience possible. We will continue to support the title. If you have any feedback on this update or just the game in general, please let us know in the Steam forums or comment below. Let your shot always hit the target!

notes.title: FRESH Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/82e11a44965327818eda621fb3572a2981c7c50b.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce a new update for Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR!
Patchnote:
The dynamic was improved and the duration of the 1st and 3rd levels of the 1st Act (1.1.1.3) was reduced. At level 1 of Act 1, now appears Grenadiers with dynamite.
Minor changes in waves at the 2nd level of the 2nd Act (2.2)
The weapon was changed: "Crossbow with Dynamite & Shotgun". Now, dynamite explodes on contact with the enemy, and the shotgun fire range increased, but the rate of fire is reduced.
Added a tutorial when a new weapon is received.
Minor fixes.
Corrected Chinese localization.
Added voice over to the Chinese.
Added localization to German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese languages.
Added an encyclopedia with the description of the different types of enemies and bosses.
Added an encyclopedia with the description of the various arsenal of weapon.

Have much fun and lucky shots, cowboys!

notes.title: Guns'n'Stories Bulletproof VR UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/82e11a44965327818eda621fb3572a2981c7c50b.jpg[/img]
Hey Cowboys out there! There is a huge update for the Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR which is right around the corner! 
Not only that we fixed some small bugs, we have upgraded the overall game dynamics and it really looks way cooler! The looong first and third levels of the 1st act have become shorter to keep you in tension!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/555127bb41267178096943d026966cc22a703b76.jpg[/img]
Update also features kinda nerdy stuff: we've added Enemies and Weapon Arsenal Encyclopedia, where you can study everything about the enemy troops and your beloved guns with which you are going to face the enemy forces!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/ee2d34fd3e747acb5d5a5c30bbb228b3cc3ac970.jpg[/img]
Also we have added the french, german, italian, spanish, korean and japanesse localization so that the Wild West Stories can go beyound all borders!
Get ready to play, Cowboy and Good Luck!

notes.title: The release version of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof will be available in March 8!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/486a426a11f139cdf9269952c099aa6b0bad34e1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Friends![/h1] 

We’ve been waiting for this moment for a long time and now we are happy to announce that the development of VR Western Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof is now on the finish line!

Looking back at the path that we have passed since the advent of the game in Early Access, we see as our project has grown up and we completely understand that we couldn't do this without your feedback and support.

As the special thanks, all owners of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof will receive six bonus levels after the release – they will opened after the main storyline is completed. 
In addition to that, new guns, game features and achievements will also be added!

The release version of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof will be available in March 8, 2018, in Steam and Oculus stores for $19.99!


[h1]Bonus levels:[/h1]

[b] Cabaret:[/b] 
[list]
[*]A hot spot that that may not survive the attack of bandits.
[*]Players will have to keep the defense of the building trying to eliminate all enemies not allowing the heated bandits inside the building.
[*]New enemies: Naked giants with hearts over their heads
[/list]
[b] Whiskey Storage:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Our whiskey is under the threat!
[*]Bandits aim to stop the loading of boxes with whiskey on the rail station using a new type of drones. You can’t lose your whiskey!
[*]New enemies: Drones wearing sombreros.
[/list]
[b] Happy Farm:[/b] 
[list]
[*]You have to protect the Bill's barn with his favorite piggy inside!
[*]Bandits decided to harm Bill, sending to his farm squads with explosives.
[*]New enemies: Bombers with dynamite.
[/list]
[b] Bandits Camp:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Sweet revenge!
[*]Bill decides to take revenge on the robbers for the farm and strikes back! Bill is consistently teleported to the key points of the Camp, smashing everything on his way.
[/list]
[b] Bank Robbery:[/b] 
[list]
[*]There is no good without a bank robbery!
[*]The gold stock of the entire state is under the threat, and the situation cannot be solved without Bill and his beloved guns.
[*]All your reaction speed is required here. Your enemies can die from 1 or 2 nice shots but their shots do double-damage.
[/list]
[b] Bill’s Nightmare:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Well, hell!
[*]Bill sees a nightmare in which he finds himself in the cemetery..
[*]New enemies: Don’t worry, there will be no tiresome zombies.
[*]New weapon: Six-barrel machine gun "Best Friend"
[/list]

[h1]New game features:[/h1]
[list]

[*][b] Digital indication[/b]  of the inflicted damage (can be turned off in the menu settings).
Now you will know for sure how much damage you do when hit the armor, head or a body. Oh, yeah, – the same goes for the hats!

[*][b] Stars: [/b] 
Everybody knows that the Sheriff Stars are never too much.
That is why we’ve decided to encourage the quick-fire shooters with not only scoring but also with sheriff stars. After each level!
The more points you gain the more stars you receive. (At the moment five stars were able to get only our lead programmer. Сheater!)

[*][b] Achievements:[/b] 
It’s no good to do without super-duper gaming achievements, whose memorable signs will decorate the honorable list of your trophies?
For instance, not everyone can lose in the first 30 seconds of the game! True?
You will have to play hard to collect them all!
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased damage from headshots.
We’ve decided to increase the damage from headshots, so that the most accurate shooters could sip their whiskey slowly, killing enemies from afar.
[*]A bug with language selection is fixed.
[*]Various skins for enemies.

[/list]

notes.title: Road to Release!
notes.notes:
The release of the Third Act of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof is behind, which means that now the game has a completed storyline and we have fully fulfilled all the promises to the fans!

Why is the game still in early access, you ask?

It's simple! During the development of the game we collected a lot of feedback from the fans and experimented. There were many ideas.
Some of them we plan to bring into the game for release - in the bonus levels, which will be an additional gratitude for everyone who purchased the game and supported the development of VR-gaming and our work!

Next week we will tell you more about the release version of the game, but for now - a few screenshots from the one of bonus levels!
